label: 038 post-hoc addition: harmonic regression forecaster, with and without smoothing and detrending
status: POST-HOC: added after the 038 verdicts were read (dcc4f2b9); the rule, costs, folds and scorer are unchanged from preregistration.json. Verdicts for these methods are labelled post-hoc and do not change the 038 conclusion's pre-registered status.
why: FFT extrapolation is periodic in the window length (forecast h ahead = window value h-1), so it was marked unavailable; harmonic regression estimates frequencies off-grid and extends them.
rule: identical to preregistration.json (decision, costs, verdict_bps 5, min_trades_per_half 200, max_fail_share 0.05, bootstrap, selection)

harm.params: harmonic_forecaster n_harmonics=3, pad 16, least-squares frequency refinement, 5 joint rounds; no smoothing, no detrending

harm_s.params: as harm + trailing 4-candle mean (causal) before fitting

harm_d.params: as harm + a straight line fitted jointly with the sinusoids and extended forward

library_note: the base smooth() (centred, zero-padded: the window's last value collapses) and base retrend (adds past window-position trend to forecasts) are broken at the window edge (038 D9/D10); the harmonic forecaster implements its own causal smoothing and extended trend instead
